name: @infrawrench/workflow-runtime
//sideEffects: All modules only define functions/consts; no import-time side effects. Combined with the sandbox-free ./client subpath, this keeps the QuickJS sandbox (sandbox.js → memfs → node:buffer) out of the desktop renderer bundle.
